promise: Target 8% economic growth by 2029, projecting 5.8-6.5% in 2027 under appropriate economic and fiscal policies
description: In his May 20, 2026 budget-framework address, Prabowo projected 5.8-6.5% growth in 2027 on a path toward 8% by 2029, conditional on appropriate and sustainable policies.
evidence: Official transcript establishes the projections; their target years remain ahead.

promise: Target Indonesian economic growth of 8% by 2029
description: Prabowo presented the government's 2027 macroeconomic framework, including a 5.8%-6.5% growth assumption and a longer-term target of 8% by 2029.
evidence: The Cabinet Secretariat records the May 20, 2026 parliamentary address; the 2029 target remains prospective.

promise: Aim to raise Japan's nationwide average minimum wage to JPY 1,500 during the 2020s
description: Ishiba set the target in his October 4, 2024 policy speech and reiterated it in January 2025. The deadline is the end of the 2020s.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the retrieved policy speeches establish the target, but no final nationwide wage outcome for the target period was located.

promise: Expect Ford Model e to reach profitability by 2029
description: Ford announced a revised EV strategy and a Model e profitability target for 2029, with improvements expected from 2026.
evidence: Ford's second-quarter 2026 update reported a narrower Model e loss; that is progress, not fulfillment of the 2029 target.

promise: Expect about USD 7 billion in incremental annual free cash flow by 2029 versus the 2025 baseline
description: ConocoPhillips reiterated its project and cost-improvement forecast in its August 6, 2026 results. The outlook depends on execution and commodity-price assumptions; it is not guaranteed cash generation.
evidence: The company's earlier calls describe incremental free cash flow and expected project start-ups; the August 2026 release reiterates the 2029 target.
